working_tree: Includes pending guide and Swift weak-capture edits
limitations: Not a controlled benchmark or proof of improved productivity.
Application tests are separate evidence, not agent outcome counts.

tasks.prompt: Identify the 429/reconnect change points and checks.
tasks.answer: UsageStore in Store.swift enforces retry deadlines; RetryPolicy in Models.swift parses and bounds Retry-After. StoreTests in Tests/store_tests.swift verifies menu, timer, manual refresh and reconnect cannot bypass the wait, then exactly one retry occurs at the deadline.

tasks.prompt: Determine whether Boolean usage numbers require a new rejection change.
tasks.answer: No edit required: Parse.double in Models.swift rejects CFBoolean before NSNumber conversion. Tests/regression.swift asserts true/false rejection and rejects Codex used_percent=true.

UsageStore invalidates the connection generation, clears the card and login window, and delegates removal of app-owned data to LiveBackend. Claude CLI disconnect resets only its app token cache; CLI-owned credentials remain untouched. Shared web sign-in data is cleared only when the disconnected connection was web and no other web connection remains. StoreTests covers both shared sign-in retention and CLI cache-only removal.
